title: Hisab Pune product readiness checklist

items.item: Pune civic accountability outcome and evidence boundary are explicit
items.status: Partial — architecture and design name the English-only multi-category ledger; no linked current-source acceptance gate exists.
completed_evidence: ARCHITECTURE.md names the civic ledger, anonymous-default authorship, and non-goals.
remaining_work: Attach and pass a current-source acceptance gate for the product contract.
completion_criteria: A linked acceptance gate confirms the frozen product contract and evidence boundaries.

items.item: A citizen can locate who answers and publish a multi-category issue
items.status: Partial — Phases A, C scaffold, and E are implemented; /how is not driven by /v1/freshness. Live Activity is deferred.
completed_evidence: Roster, /v1/here, reports, comments, session auth, locality feed, city signal, and iOS Here/Report/widget exist.
remaining_work: Render /how from GET /v1/freshness and stop using src/data/sources.ts as the freshness owner.
completion_criteria: The How page shows API freshness facts; the static sources list is not the public freshness owner.

items.item: The frozen current-source release gate passes
items.status: Pending — graders, API tests, Playwright smoke, and XCUITest exist; no frozen-source testing-framework receipt is retained.
remaining_work: Run the testing-framework release gate on one frozen revision and retain the receipt.
completion_criteria: The testing-framework release gate passes on the checklist source revision with a retained receipt and no blocking ledger debt.

items.item: Roster, reports, and storage stay portable and honest
items.status: Partial — SQLite with a Postgres-shaped schema and seed exist; photo object storage and PostGIS are not in this target.
completed_evidence: Versioned roster, reports, comments, and seed load on SQLite.
remaining_work: Keep schema portable; do not claim PostGIS or photo object storage until those land.
completion_criteria: Current target storage matches the claimed environment, with a named path for photos and PostGIS when required.

items.item: Auth, public authorship, and privacy boundaries hold
items.status: Partial — MVP session and anonymous_posting_id exist; phone OTP is deferred. Public APIs must not leak author_user_id.
completed_evidence: POST /v1/auth/session assigns anonymous_posting_id; publish_as defaults to anonymous.
remaining_work: Keep author_user_id off public payloads; replace the session stub with phone OTP only when that target is opened.
completion_criteria: Public APIs never expose author_user_id, email, phone, or session identifiers; the current auth gate matches the claimed target.
items.reentry_trigger: Open phone OTP when replacing the session stub.

items.item: SLA digest, freshness flags, and operator recovery
items.status: Deferred — no SLA digest job or @HisabPune batching in this target.
items.reentry_trigger: Open when shipping the SLA digest job and @HisabPune batches.

items.status: Not required — public civic ledger; no customer billing or money movement.

items.item: Apple portal, host, and honest gov adapters
items.status: Blocked — Simulator signing exists; portal App IDs and App Group registration need explicit authorize. CARE stays a fail-closed stub.
remaining_work: With explicit authorize, register App IDs and the App Group for device and TestFlight.
completion_criteria: Device and TestFlight use registered App IDs and App Group group.in.hisab.pune; gov writes stay fail-closed until a real adapter exists.
items.blocked_by: Operator must explicitly authorize Apple portal App ID and App Group registration.
items.operator_boundary: Do not create App IDs, profiles, or use -allowProvisioningUpdates without explicit operator authorize.
items.reentry_trigger: Open real gov write adapters only when a public or partner API exists.

items.item: Production host, rollback, and public launch path
items.status: Pending — Deploy workflow rebuilds an artifact; the production host step is a placeholder.
remaining_work: Replace the deploy host placeholder, verify rollback, and record an explicit launch decision.
completion_criteria: A named production host serves the current artifact, rollback is known, and the operator accepts launch.
items.operator_boundary: Do not deploy or send launch communications without explicit approval.

items.status: Not ready — required outcomes remain open.
remaining_work: Close every required open item, then record the decision against the frozen release source.
completion_criteria: All required items are complete, the current-source testing gate passes, and the product lead records go or no-go.

current_blocker: How page still uses a static sources list instead of GET /v1/freshness. Apple portal App IDs remain unauthorized for device and TestFlight.
next_action: Drive /how from GET /v1/freshness so the static sources list is not the freshness owner.
warning: Local CI and Simulator proof do not establish TestFlight, production host, or frozen-source release acceptance.
